'''Impact''' was an illegal type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] derived from [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]], popular among [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. It would temporarily increase the user's reflexes, but then result in a lethargic crash. Despite [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attempts to crack down on the spice, the use of Impact was on the rise during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
